items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Oh, he did? Johnny? Johnny Cruz?

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: This man could pick the bass. He would go and play with the fiddle. He used to pick it with his fingers.
Oh, he did? Johnny? Johnny Cruz?

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: He played with the fiddle and pick it. He'd rip that bass. Vroom, vroom, vroom, vroom, vroom, vroom, vroom. So he could play with the fiddle and pick it. They used to play good. They had the old house rocking.
